C001.reason: Remove the assignment of the 'name' field to the fields dictionary for v1 entities as per the intended behavior.

C002.reason: Remove the assignment of the 'name' field during v1 entity construction as per the intended behavior.

rationale: The intended behavior requires removing Entity.name from v1 construction, reads, and decoded observations. C001 handles the read/observation part in process_entity, and C002 handles the construction part in the main block. Both are removed to comply with the schema change where field 2 is now reserved.
